response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean FROM t;

assumptions.assumption: Lines with amount = 0 give a NULL ratio in SQLite (division by zero). They are ignored in the averages, as the request says to ignore missing values. Events left with no valid rate drop out of their type's average.
The per-type mean is taken over all types that have a non-null average rate. A NULL type, if one exists, counts as its own group.
